description: A React component for a modal dialog allowing users to confirm leaving a team, with different messages for guests and regular users, handling keyboard events and actions to leave the team.

classes.name: LeaveTeamModal
classes.description: A React component class for the leave team confirmation modal.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with show set to true.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show to false.

methods.name: handleKeyPress
methods.description: Handles keypress events, triggers submit on Enter key.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Executes leave team action and toggles sidebar.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal with dynamic message based on user role and channel counts.
